The printed glyph is 5th-order 'ሄደ' (he went), not 3rd-order 'ሂደ'.
The printed glyph is 5th-order 'የሄዱ' (who went), not 'የሂዱ'.

Splits mid-word across lines 30-31 to form 'ቆስጠንጢኖስ' (Constantine); the 7th-order 'ቆ' was misread as 'ቄ'.
